rule: Excavation of the same zone before blinding/foundation work
alternatives_and_applicability: Staged excavation per zone; piled foundations (piling before excavation) not covered

rule: Blinding before foundation reinforcement/formwork where blinding is specified
lag_or_condition: blinding cure/walkability time = project input (no default)
alternatives_and_applicability: No blinding (e.g. formwork on lean fill) -> rule inactive

rule: Method A (formwork first): shutter, then place cage inside
alternatives_and_applicability: Applicable to boxed strip foundations and pits
evidence: OBSERVED SCH: 2015-03-04 Bekisten liftvloer; 2015-03-04 Wapening liftvloer; 2015-03-06 Bekisten liftwanden; 2015-03-09 Wapening liftwanden; 2015-03-12 Stellen funderingkist incl. poeren; 2015-03-19 Wapening; 2015-04-01 Wapening ; 2015-04-14 Bekisten ; 2015-05-13 Wapening; 2015-06-11 Wapening; 2015-07-07 Wapening;

rule: Method B (reinforcement first): prefabricated cages, then formwork
alternatives_and_applicability: Alternative to DR03a - exactly one of DR03a/DR03b per element group

rule: Reinforcement and formwork complete (and inspected) before foundation concrete
evidence: OBSERVED SCH: 2015-03-05 Stort liftvloer; 2015-03-10 Stort liftwanden; 2015-03-25 Stort; 2015-03-26 Opstorten fundering; 2015-04-03 Stort; 2015-05-19 Stort; 2015-06-15 Stort; 2015-07-09 Stort; 2015-08-20 Stort

alternatives_and_applicability: Prefabricated cage + system formwork may overlap (SS)

rule: Reinforcement and formwork before placement where the method requires both
alternatives_and_applicability: Slab/beam: formwork usually precedes reinforcement (soffit first); walls: one face, rebar, second face
evidence: PROPOSED_RULE; SCH lift walls observed as Bekisten -> Wapening -> Stort

lag_or_condition: curing duration/criterion = engineer input (NO universal default)
alternatives_and_applicability: Cold-weather, cement type and admixtures change durations
evidence: PROPOSED_RULE; BCCA texts include curing labour in concrete items

rule: Formwork removal only after the approved striking criterion (strength or time) is met
lag_or_condition: criterion = engineer input; Spanish Codigo Estructural (cited by BCCA) governs; values NOT extracted here
alternatives_and_applicability: Side formwork vs soffit/props differ; re-propping strategies

rule: Supporting columns/walls cast and adequate before loading formwork of supported members
alternatives_and_applicability: Monolithic column-beam-slab pours; steel columns (SCH) placed before floors
evidence: OBSERVED SCH: 2015-04-13 Kanaalplaatvloer leggen (lev. week 16); 2015-04-16 Afstorten kanaalplaat; 2015-04-20 Plaatsen stalen kolommen; 2015-05-01 Leggen breedplaat incl. Veiligheid; 2015-06-03 Leggen breedplaat incl. Veiligheid; 2015-06-29 Leggen breedplaat incl. Veiligheid; 2015-07-20 Leggen breedplaat incl. Ve

rule: Vertical progression storey by storey for supported structure
alternatives_and_applicability: Zones may overlap horizontally; no inference from spatial adjacency
evidence: PROPOSED_RULE; storey evidence from IfcBuildingStorey (flattened in SCH Synchro)

rule: Zone progression by crew availability, not by precedence
alternatives_and_applicability: Zones must be user-defined (IfcZone not audited)

rule: Backfill after foundation completion and inspection

alternatives_and_applicability: Load-bearing masonry may PRECEDE the floor it supports (SCH sand-lime walls before breedplaat)
evidence: OBSERVED SCH: 2015-04-07 Stelwerk metselwerk onder peil; 2015-04-08 Metselwerk onderpeil (buitenblad); 2015-04-21 Stelwerk kalkzandsteen; 2015-04-22 Lijmwerk kalkzandsteen elementen; 2015-05-22 Stelwerk kalkzandsteen; 2015-05-26 Lijmwerk kalkzandsteen elementen; 2015-06-18 Stelwerk kalkzandsteen; 2015-06-19 Lijmw

rule: Precast floor units before topping concrete
evidence: OBSERVED SCH: 2015-04-13 Kanaalplaatvloer leggen (lev. week 16); 2015-04-16 Afstorten kanaalplaat

rule: Spatial adjacency, contact or containment alone NEVER creates a dependency
